topPRs.title: validation: add op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3 standard versions
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
Adds `op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3` blocks to `standard-versions-sepolia.toml` and `standard-versions-mainnet.toml`.

Implementations were deployed with `op-deployer bootstrap implementations` built from the `op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3` tag. Only the OPContractsManager changed relative to v8.0.0-rc.2 (OPCMV2 v8.0.1 — sepolia `0x6abfabbc793883add5fa308a97163e8225a9f4ca`, mainnet `0x1951828ce913dc4383a8a1695695d537a11d896a`); all other implementation addresses are unchanged. Contracts are verified on Blockscout.
